clips.title: The story
paras: The Forsaken hold the Sepulcher above Silverpine Forest’s western coast. Once a Lordaeron graveyard and burial crypt, it is now a fortified Horde refuge amid threats from across the region.

The Sepulcher crowns the hills above Lordaeron’s western coast. You find an old cemetery and stone crypt beside the western road, now held by the Forsaken. Since the Third War, they have made its grounds and ancient vault a vital outpost. Danger presses from every side: feral worgen stalk the south, Scourge remnants wander east, and Kirin Tor wizards watch from Ambermill. For travelers crossing Silverpine, the Sepulcher offers shelter, supplies, and a place of command.
